# jenkins — 2016 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 18 jenkins CVEs of 2016 are in `data/cve/vendors/jenkins/2016.jsonl`.

### CVE-2016-0792
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2016-04-07 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 42394: Jenkins < 1.650 - Java Deserialization (remote/java, 2017-07-30, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 43375: Jenkins - XStream Groovy classpath Deserialization (Metasploit) (remote/multiple, 2017-12-19, verified=1)

Multiple unspecified API endpoints in Jenkins before 1.650 and LTS before 1.642.2 allow remote authenticated users to execute arbitrary code via serialized data in an XML file, related to XStream and groovy.util.Expando.

### CVE-2016-9299
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2017-01-12 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 44642: Jenkins CLI - HTTP Java Deserialization (Metasploit) (remote/linux, 2018-05-17, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 44642: Jenkins CLI - HTTP Java Deserialization (Metasploit) (remote/linux, 2018-05-17, verified=1)

The remoting module in Jenkins before 2.32 and LTS before 2.19.3 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted serialized Java object, which triggers an LDAP query to a third-party server.
